findings.title: Guard the missing destination before checking its integration
findings.body: When a Google Meet event has no destination calendar, destructuring the empty array leaves mainHostDestinationCalendar undefined. Reading its integration throws instead of falling back to Cal Video as before. Booking creation therefore fails for Google Meet event types whose calendar was disconnected or is otherwise unset.

findings.title: Select the destination belonging to the current credential
findings.body: EventManager now calls this service separately for every collective host but passes the entire destinationCalendar array each time. This service always uses the first host's calendar ID with the current host's access token. Secondary Office 365 hosts (including those paired with a Google organizer) therefore attempt to write to another account's calendar and fail rather than receiving an event. LarkCalendarService and BaseCalendarService have the same first-element selection problem; these services need credential-specific destination selection as Google now has.

findings.title: Restore the destination fallback for references without a calendar ID
findings.body: When externalCalendarId is null or absent, the new fallback searches for a destination whose externalId equals that absent value, so it cannot select a configured calendar. Google updates then receive an undefined calendarId and fail. The analogous deletion fallback defaults to primary, leaving events on non-primary calendars undeleted while treating Google's 404 as success. This affects existing references without externalCalendarId, including the credential-less destination creation branch that still does not populate result.externalId.

findings.title: Preserve the credential ID on video references
findings.body: The reference builder now sets credentialId to undefined for every non-calendar result, discarding the credential ID returned by createMeeting. The cancellation handler only deletes video meetings when their reference has a credentialId, so newly created Zoom and other dedicated video meetings will no longer be deleted when their booking is cancelled. Retain result.credentialId for video results.

findings.title: Initialize destinations before adding collective co-host calendars
findings.body: If neither the event type nor the organizer has a destination calendar, evt.destinationCalendar is initialized to null. The optional push then silently drops all teamDestinationCalendars, even when other collective hosts have connected calendars. Those hosts receive no directly created calendar events. Initialize an empty array or assign the collected destinations instead of skipping the append.

findings.title: Cancel recurring events using each reference's credential
findings.body: The new outer loop resolves each collective host's credential, but the allRemainingBookings branch ignores that credential and loops only over the booking owner's credentials, selecting only the first calendar reference of each occurrence. Consequently cancelling an entire collective recurring series leaves secondary hosts' calendar events intact, despite marking all bookings cancelled. Iterate each updated booking's references and delete each with its matching credential.

findings.title: Do not invert organization slug assignment
findings.body: The previous code assigned the organization slug when team billing was disabled and stored only requestedSlug when billing was enabled. This change reverses the slug condition: billing-disabled installations now create organizations without a slug, while billing-enabled installations assign the requested slug immediately rather than deferring it. This unrelated change breaks organization URL provisioning and should retain the original condition.
